Romi: Quick experiment idea  run a micro-launch tying 100 free credits -> 2 prompt packs -> one 30-min workshop. Hypothesis: +10% signup->3-queries in 48h.

Carter: Sounds good. Cohort size?

Romi: 250 seeded signups, split A/B. A gets webinar + credits + templates, B gets credits + templates only.

Leah: Prompt packs: 'prototype-starter' and 'outreach-templates'. Social teaser: `100 starter credits + prompt packs. Join our 30-min live workshop.`

Omar: Routing: add ?utm_infl=NAME and set signup metadata seed=true. Bypass main tour, open templates modal on first login.

Carter: Metrics I'll track: signup->3 queries (48h), avg queries/day, 7d retention. Dashboard link when ready.

Leah: Timeline: assets + landing by Mon EOD, routing live Tue 9AM PT, posts Tue 10AM PT, webinar Wed 4PM PT.

Romi: Action items: Leah (copy + assets), Omar (routing + cohort flag), Carter (analytics), deploy-bot schedule event. Check-in tomorrow 10AM PT. :rocket:

deploy-bot: Created event "Micro-launch: credits + workshop" Wed 16:00 PT  invite sent to #marketing.

Omar: Ops note  require email verify before credit claim to limit spam. Rollback: pause credit issuance if spam detected.

Romi: Great. Keep the variants tight so we can attribute webinar effect. Update the launch doc and drop links here.
